g.title: cycle_validity
g.text: Validity of one cycle: reasons invalidate, annotations only explain

g.title: r2
g.text: SYN dropped at own or target listener

g.title: r6
g.text: driver, VF or ring sizes changed

g.title: a1
g.text: lateness p99 > 1 ms or max > 10 ms

g.text: another listener in the netns dropped
